name: Tír na Thonn
text: Tír na Thonn is a variant form of the name Tir fo Thuinn. The dictionary prints the head as a one-line cross-reference. The record of the Land under Wave sits under the Tir fo Thuinn node. Both forms name the realm beneath the waves.
